summary: Iter 220p1 — Data Quality Dashboard (Master Price List). Backend 9/9 pytest pass. Frontend end-to-end (login -> Settings -> Price List -> Data quality -> modal -> drill-down -> CSV -> product drawer) verified against the real preview URL.

backend_pytest: test_quality_dashboard_shape — 200, all 11 issue keys + by_category + health_score (typed)
test_quality_report_csv_attachment — text/csv, attachment, BOM, exact header row Product Code,Name,Category,Sage Code,Cost Price,Sell Price,Margin %,Status
frontend_playwright: Login via /login (placeholder you@gym.com) with admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123! lands on /crm
crm-toolbar-settings -> settings-tab-products renders Master Price List section
products-quality-btn present in header actions row
Click opens data-quality-modal; quality-health-score = 4% (51 products, 49 need attention)
11 quality-card-<issue> cards render with correct counts (missing_sage=49, missing_sell=7, missing_cost=47, never_quoted=43, with_unmapped=47, recently_changed=51, others=0)
Click non-zero quality-card-missing_sage opens quality-drill (49 rows, quality-item-* per row)
Click drill row opens product-drawer with full product details (Name/SKU/Sage/Cost/Sell/Price history) — confirms GET /api/crm/products/{id} integration
Row click intentionally closes modal (per code: setShowQuality(false))

critical_code_review_comments: CRMDataQualityModal.js swallows axios errors silently (catch blocks empty) — fine for graceful degradation but consider surfacing a toast/inline error on load/drill failure so users know data is stale.

After clicking a drill-down row the modal is closed (intentional) and the product drawer opens — verify this is the desired UX; some users may expect modal to remain open behind drawer for quick back-navigation.

_issue_query in crm_price_quality.py uses {sku: '\x00__none__'} as a no-match sentinel when dup_skus is empty — works, but a {$expr:{$eq:[1,0]}} sentinel would be more explicit and avoid relying on a magic SKU never existing.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created — used existing tenant catalogue (51 live products)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (no default). Run from /app/backend with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$URL python -m pytest tests/test_iter_220p1_quality.py. CRM login goes via /api/crm/auth/login token field 'token'. UI nav: /login -> /crm -> crm-toolbar-settings -> settings-tab-products -> products-quality-btn -> data-quality-modal. Clicking a drill row closes modal and opens product-drawer (by design).
